subject: c12-eng

weightage.label: Literature: Flamingo Prose, Flamingo Poetry, Vistas (Ch 3 to 5)

note: Marks are official (theory total 80; internal assessment 20 = listening and speaking 5+5, project work 10). Reading is 22 marks (12 + 10: an unseen passage and a case-based factual passage). Creative writing is 18 marks: notice 4, invitation and reply 4, letter 5, article or report 5. Literature carries 40 marks.
mistakes: Every writing question gives 1 mark for spelling and grammar, so proofread each answer.
Notice and invitation and reply have a limit of 50 words. Letters and articles or reports have a limit of about 120 to 150 words. Follow the limit and the format.
Short-answer reading questions are answered in 40 to 50 words. Answer only what is asked, using the passage for evidence.
For the case-based passage, read the data, charts or other visual input carefully before answering.
In literature answers, refer to the text of the lesson or poem instead of writing a general answer.
order: Literature first (Ch 3 to 5, 40 marks): the largest block. Read each lesson and poem and write short notes.
Practise one unseen passage and one case-based passage each week (22 marks).
Practise each writing format in turn: notice, invitation and reply, letter, article or report (18 marks).
Keep listening, speaking and project work (20 internal marks) on schedule with your school.
